intent: Find an app that turns fridge contents into recipes
title: Fridge Recipe App – Turn What’s in Your Fridge into Dinner
description: A fridge recipe app starts from food you already have. Learn how fridge-based cooking works and how Delixio helps you generate meal ideas from your ingredients.
intro: A fridge recipe app is built for the everyday moment when you open the fridge, see random ingredients, and need dinner. Instead of browsing recipes that assume a full shopping trip, you start with what is already there.
Delixio is designed for that workflow: type ingredients, set preferences, choose a cooking mode, explore free meal ideas, and unlock a full recipe when you want to cook, on iPhone or Android.

sections.heading: What a good fridge recipe workflow looks like
list: Type or add ingredients quickly (no full fridge inventory, barcode, or camera required).
Remember pantry staples you always have (My Kitchen in Delixio).
Respect preferences, servings, cooking time, and meal type.
Show whether a recipe needs extra shopping.
Help you save the meals that worked.
paragraphs: If an app only stores recipes and never starts from your fridge, it is a cookbook, useful, but not the same problem.

sections.heading: Fridge cooking tips that work without any app
paragraphs: Keep a short “use soon” mental list every time you open the fridge. Cook those items first.
Keep a few bridge ingredients at home: eggs, tortillas, pasta, rice, canned tomatoes, beans, frozen vegetables, yogurt, lemon, garlic.
Batch-cook one base (rice, roasted vegetables, shredded chicken) that can become bowls, wraps, or soups later in the week.

sections.heading: Where Delixio fits
paragraphs: Delixio adds AI recipe ideas on top of ingredient-first cooking, then full recipes when you unlock them, plus grocery lists, saved recipes with lists (Favorites, Quick dinners, Healthy, and custom), notes, ratings, mark cooked, and a meal calendar with optional one-way export to your device calendar. My Kitchen stores pantry staples so everyday basics are available without re-entering them, and they stay off the grocery list unless needed.

delixio.heading: Try Delixio as your fridge-to-recipe companion
paragraphs: Download Delixio, type what is in your fridge, choose Strict if you want to avoid shopping, or Flexible if one or two extras are fine, then generate dinner ideas.
Ideas are free. Unlocking a full recipe uses 1 credit, including 1 free full recipe every day. Optional packs: 6, 28, or 90 credits. No subscription. No barcode scanner or fridge camera required.

related.label: What can I cook with these ingredients?

faq.q: What is a fridge recipe app?
faq.a: It is an app that helps you cook from ingredients you already have at home, usually by suggesting recipes around your fridge and pantry foods.

faq.q: Do I need to inventory my whole fridge?
faq.a: No. Start with the ingredients you want to cook with. Delixio uses typed ingredient chips, not a full fridge inventory, barcode scanner, or camera.

faq.q: Is Delixio available on iPhone and Android?
faq.a: Yes. Delixio is available on the App Store and Google Play.

faq.q: Can a fridge recipe app help reduce waste?
faq.a: It can help you cook with what you already bought. Delixio supports that by starting from your ingredients so leftovers and “use soon” foods get used.

card_blurb: Cook from what’s in your fridge, not from a shopping list.
